summary: In 1980s and early-1990s America, fears of secret Satanic cults abusing children, fed by evangelical grifters, repressed-memory therapy and coercive interviews of children, led to false accusations and wrongful prosecutions such as the McMartin preschool trial.
keywords: Child Abuse Prevention and Treatment Act

evidence.note: US groundwork begins: cult fears after the 1969 Manson murders and the Satanic Bible
long segment on Mike Warnke, fake ex-Satanist author and Christian comedian
1973-74 CAPTA and therapy-led child-protection system that later enabled the panic
1980 book Michelle Remembers and Pazder's hypnotic regression claims
repressed memory therapy revived in late 1970s; false memory implantation explained
Kern County case begins in 1980 with the McCuan and Kniffen families
Kniffen sons recant and convictions are overturned in 1996
McMartin preschool in Manhattan Beach, Southern California
1984 grand jury indictments; DA pursued case for re-election; Buckey jailed five years
McMartin jury verdict after 28 months of testimony (1990)
suicides of Dallas Egbert and Irving Pulling blamed on Dungeons and Dragons
1993 West Memphis murders of three boys described, with mutilation claims

notes: Opening on Lyon in 177, blood libel, witch hunts and 1830s anti-Catholic tales is background and excluded from covered_span. QAnon is a running comparison, not followed as legacy, so reaches_present is false. West Memphis Three and the D&D panic each get ~6 min but did not fit the 5-subject cap; they are in keywords. The transcript dates the West Memphis plea to 2010 (actually 2011); it is a one-line coda and not used for covered_span.
